newsitem.title: BELGIUM: Belgian PM to bid for new term after all - paper.
newsitem.headline: Belgian PM to bid for new term after all - paper.

text.p: Belgian Prime Minister Jean-Luc Dehaene will seek a third term as prime minister at the 1999 elections after all, Belgian daily La Libre Belgique said.
The Christian-Democratic Dehaene had told La Libre and De Standaard on October 7 that he would not make a bid for a third term in the country's highest office.
"I will not neglect my (Christian-Democratic CVP) party nor will I run from my responsibilities," the paper quoted Dehaene as saying.
Four weeks ago, the papers quoted him as saying that "After two mandates...it is best to stop."
Dehaene's office could not immediately be reached for comment.
